decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no balustrades or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof of the extension(s). No roof of any part of the extension(s) shall be used for any recreational purpose and access shall only be for the purposes of the maintenance of the property or means of emergency escape. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

The development to which this permission relates must be completed no later than 9 months from the date of the decision notice unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure the timely regularisation of the unauthorised development in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location and Block Plan 119PA-01Existing Ground Floor Plan 119PA-02Proposed Ground Floor Demolition Plan 119PA-03Proposed Ground Floor Plan 119PA-04Existing Elevations 119PA-05Proposed Elevations 119PA-06Existing Section AA' 119PA-07Proposed Section AA' 119PA-08Proposed Block Plan 119PA-09Planning StatementFRA & SuDS Appraisal ReportReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Partial demolition of the existing single storey rear extension with reduction / modification of retained extension. (RETROSPECTIVE)
